decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 2 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - The works to bring the development in accordance with the submitted plans shall be completed within six months of the date of this permission or such extended time as must first be agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Partial demolition of rear wall and parapet, plus retention of side extension to basement, ground and first floors and single storey rear extension to basement incorporating internal and external alterations.
